lines.speaker: B
lines.pinyin: Wǒ hé péngyou qù Běijīng lǚyóu.
lines.english: My friend and I go to Beijing to travel.

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 不，我们坐公共汽车去。便宜。
lines.pinyin: Bù, wǒmen zuò gōnggòng qìchē qù. Piányi.
lines.english: No, we take the bus. It's cheaper.

lines.speaker: A
lines.pinyin: Jǐ diǎn zǒu? Qù duō cháng shíjiān?
lines.english: What time do you leave? How long will you be away?

lines.speaker: B
lines.pinyin: Bā diǎn zǒu. Qù sān tiān.
lines.english: Leave at eight. We will go for three days.

lines.speaker: A
lines.pinyin: Xīwàng nǐmen wán de hěn gāoxìng!
lines.english: Hope you have a lot of fun!
